destination.instructions: Name the one skill that should run this request. Prefer a domain skill over a universal one. A named skill routes to itself.

criteria.grill-with-docs: Build or change a feature, 3+ concerns, multi-file; Idea to shipped feature
criteria.architect: Shape types and module boundaries before code
criteria.state-brief: Design a flow with three or more states, or one a job, webhook, timer or another person can move
criteria.state-audit: Audit a built flow for flag soup, hidden transitions or missing recovery
criteria.to-spec: Turn a settled design into a written spec
criteria.feature-ledger: Reconcile a large feature's PRD, design, contract and code
criteria.superpowers:writing-plans: Write an implementation plan from requirements
criteria.investigate-thoven: Something is broken at runtime in Thoven; Bug report
criteria.diagnosing-bugs: A hard bug or perf regression anywhere
criteria.verify-this: Prove one specific claim with fresh evidence
criteria.qa-flow: Product-level evidence on a real user path
criteria.create-verification-skill: This repo has no control skill or Feature Map
criteria.maintain-verification-skill: An existing verify-app map is stale
criteria.workspace: Where does this stand, log work, move a ticket
criteria.thoven-designer: A new component, page, or redesign; Is this value locked, which token binds it; New component; New component with motion; Screen from a frame
criteria.building-components: Build a component from scratch, accessible and composable
criteria.prototype: Try several versions of a surface and pick one
criteria.better-interface: A full quality pass across the interface
criteria.better-ui: Radius, depth, hit areas, icon choice
criteria.accessibility-check: Check a shipped surface against a11y rules
criteria.impeccable: Critique, audit, polish, harden, distill, clarify a surface; Make it bolder, quieter, more delightful, animate it; Set up or extract a design system, run live browser iteration; Pre-ship quality pass
criteria.mobile-audit: How this behaves on a phone
criteria.design-research: Explore a UX pattern before designing
criteria.motion: Unsure which animation approach, or describing a feel
criteria.transitions-dev: Open, close, swap, badge, page transition in CSS
criteria.improve-animations: Audit a codebase's motion and plan fixes
criteria.review-animations: Review a motion diff against a craft bar
criteria.next-best-practices: Next App Router, routing, data fetching
criteria.playwright-expert: Drive or inspect a real browser
criteria.deslop: Strip AI slop from a diff
criteria.no-comments: Remove comments that restate the code
criteria.code-review: Review a branch against standards and spec
criteria.api-endpoint: A new endpoint or fetch wrapper
criteria.product-fundamentals: Brainstorm or grill a feature, journey or flow; what matters most
criteria.babysit-pr: Watch a PR through CI and comments without me
criteria.loop-on-ci: Watch CI in the terminal until it passes
criteria.fix-ci: CI is red on a PR
criteria.modernize: An old PR or branch is behind main, "rebase this"
criteria.takeover: Pick up another person's or agent's PR, branch or dead pane
criteria.full-stop: Take a ticket to ready-to-merge unattended
criteria.remote-check: Run a heavy check on the mini against MacBook changes
criteria.linear-project: Set up or reshape a Linear Project
criteria.text-product-analysis: What families are texting about, a feedback sweep
criteria.build-design: Build a Figma or board frame
criteria.state-machine: Work on every state of one component
criteria.break: Stress test a component under every scenario
criteria.variant: Iterate on variants of the component being built
criteria.interface-review: Review the UI changes in a branch or PR
criteria.thoven-art: Art, stickers, icons or Thovie for a page
criteria.explain-interface: How was this site or effect built
criteria.animate: Build one new animation from scratch
